title: Webflow Integrations
head:
<!-- Nues: Webflow Integrations page code. Edit here, not in embeds. -->
<style>
/* Hero: green glow at the top fading into the dark green below, like the design */
.integ-hero{background-image:radial-gradient(60% 45% at 50% 0%,rgba(46,96,66,.5) 0%,rgba(46,96,66,0) 100%),linear-gradient(180deg,#1a3226 0%,#132619 55%,#0d1a13 100%)}
/* Logo marquee: the top row runs left, the bottom row runs right; the script adds a copy of each row so the loop has no seam */
.integ-hero_track{will-change:transform}
.integ-hero_logos.is-running .integ-hero_track{animation:integ-marquee var(--integ-speed,45s) linear infinite}
.integ-hero_row[data-direction="right"] .integ-hero_track{animation-direction:reverse}
@keyframes integ-marquee{from{transform:translate3d(0,0,0)}to{transform:translate3d(-100%,0,0)}}
/* FAQ: same accordion as Pricing */
.pr-faq_q:focus-visible,.pr-faq_link:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #5bd3a9;outline-offset:3px}
.pr-faq_link{text-decoration-color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);text-underline-offset:3px}
.pr-faq_icon{transition:background-color .2s ease}
.pr-faq_q:hover .pr-faq_icon{background-color:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.pr-faq_a{transition:grid-template-rows .35s ease}
.pr-faq_bar{transition:transform .3s ease}
.pr-faq_list.pr-js .pr-faq_a{grid-template-rows:0fr}
.pr-faq_list.pr-js .pr-faq_item.is-open .pr-faq_a{grid-template-rows:1fr}
.pr-faq_item.is-open .pr-faq_bar.is-v{transform:rotate(0deg)}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
.integ-hero_logos.is-running .integ-hero_track{animation:none}
.pr-faq_a,.pr-faq_bar,.pr-faq_icon{transition:none}
}
</style>
footer:
<!-- Nues: Webflow Integrations page code. Edit here, not in embeds. -->
<script>
(function () {
  function ready(fn) { if (document.readyState !== 'loading') fn(); else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn); }
  ready(function () {
    var uid = 0;
    function nid(p) { uid += 1; return p + '-' + uid; }

    /* Logo marquee: each row gets hidden copies of its logos so the strip loops without a gap; the speed stays the same on every screen size */
    var marquee = document.querySelector('[data-integ-marquee]');
    if (marquee && !marquee.classList.contains('is-running')) {
      var rows = [].slice.call(marquee.querySelectorAll('.integ-hero_row'));
      rows.forEach(function (row) {
        var track = row.querySelector('.integ-hero_track');
        if (!track || row.querySelectorAll('.integ-hero_track').length > 1) return;
        // Three copies cover screens up to about 2.5x the width of one set of logos
        for (var c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
          var copy = track.cloneNode(true);
          copy.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
          [].slice.call(copy.querySelectorAll('img')).forEach(function (img) { img.alt = ''; });
          row.appendChild(copy);
        }
      });
      var speed = function () {
        rows.forEach(function (row) {
          var track = row.querySelector('.integ-hero_track');
          if (track) row.style.setProperty('--integ-speed', Math.max(20, track.offsetWidth / 40) + 's');
        });
      };
      speed();
      window.addEventListener('load', speed);
      window.addEventListener('resize', speed);
      marquee.classList.add('is-running');
    }

    /* FAQ accordion */
    var list = document.querySelector('.pr-faq_list');
    if (list && !list.classList.contains('pr-js')) {
      var items = [].slice.call(list.querySelectorAll('.pr-faq_item'));
      var sets = [];
      items.forEach(function (it, i) {
        var q = it.querySelector('.pr-faq_q'), a = it.querySelector('.pr-faq_a');
        if (!q || !a) return;
        var qid = nid('integ-faq-q'), aid = nid('integ-faq-a');
        q.id = qid; a.id = aid;
        q.setAttribute('role', 'button');
        q.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
        q.setAttribute('aria-controls', aid);
        a.setAttribute('role', 'region');
        a.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', qid);
        var set = function (open) {
          it.classList.toggle('is-open', open);
          q.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
          a.setAttribute('aria-hidden', open ? 'false' : 'true');
        };
        sets[i] = set;
        set(it.classList.contains('is-open'));
        // one answer open at a time: opening one closes the others
        var toggle = function () {
          var open = !it.classList.contains('is-open');
          if (open) sets.forEach(function (s, j) { if (j !== i && s) s(false); });
          set(open);
        };
        q.addEventListener('click', toggle);
        q.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
          if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Spacebar') { e.preventDefault(); toggle(); }
        });
      });
      list.classList.add('pr-js');
    }
  });
})();
</script>
